businesses.business: royalty-based biopharmaceutical company with specialty therapeutics

offering_description.value: Innoviva earns royalties from respiratory drugs partnered with GSK and markets its own critical care and infectious disease therapies to hospitals. It also holds a portfolio of equity and healthcare investments. Products are made by contract manufacturers and sold through wholesalers.

primary_products.value: respiratory inhaled therapies (royalty stream); antibiotics for hospital infections; critical care drugs for hypotension; oral antibiotic for gonorrhea

customer_segment.value: B2B: GSK as royalty payer, hospitals, pharmacies, wholesalers and distributors

end_markets.value: respiratory disease; critical care; infectious disease; hospitals

revenue_model.value: licensing or royalties: royalties on partner-sold respiratory products such as COPD and asthma inhalers; product sales: own critical care and anti-infective drugs sold to hospitals via wholesalers; other: gains and income from equity and long-term investments
revenue_model.category: licensing or royalties; product sales; other

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: markets specialty drugs made by contract manufacturers, sold to hospitals and wholesalers; other: royalty holder collecting payments from GSK on licensed respiratory products

geography_served.value: global: royalties from worldwide partner sales, own products mainly in the US, with some international partnerships

specialization.value: related lines: royalty portfolio plus specialty critical care and infectious disease drugs, all pharmaceuticals

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: pharmaceutical wholesalers and specialty distributors supplying hospitals; direct sales: own hospital-focused commercial sales team; partners / resellers: GSK commercializes the royalty-bearing respiratory products
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: prescription drugs requiring FDA approval and oversight, foreign regulators, healthcare pricing and reimbursement rules

notes: Product details are from memory and may be outdated.
